notes: The Position map now updates as fast as the portal moves. Clicking an anchor or a monitor used to refresh the map at two fixed moments after the click, 260ms and 900ms, and then not again until a background poll came round every 1.5…
Setting an anchor also sends the change immediately instead of letting it sit on an 80ms debounce while the map races it with its own round trips.

The Height reading beside the map no longer blanks to a dash if a single position read fails. The map next to it already kept showing the last known position in that case, by design; the number did not.
